direct_official_checks: INSPIRE polygons cover freehold registered property locations
each polygon has a Land Registry-INSPIRE ID
INSPIRE ID relates to a registered title
registered title may contain several separate polygons
each separate polygon has its own INSPIRE ID
missing INSPIRE ID does not prove unregistered land
leasehold and other tenures may be absent from INSPIRE
INSPIRE extent is indicative rather than definitive title extent
quality_effect: Prevents candidate identity from being inferred from geometry alone and preserves polygon-to-title multiplicity.
